### Description

### WithInput example disabling input

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.0-beta.6

Sets the input for the program; passing nil disables input entirely. This is useful when input is not needed.

```go
p := NewProgram(model, WithInput(nil))
```

### WithInput

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea

Sets the input which, by default, is stdin. In most cases you won't need to use this. To disable input entirely pass nil.

```APIDOC
## WithInput

### Description
Sets the input which, by default, is stdin. In most cases you won't need to use this. To disable input entirely pass nil.

### Function Signature
`func WithInput(input io.Reader) ProgramOption`

### Example
```go
p := NewProgram(model, WithInput(nil))
```
